bugs_found: transfer() raises 'insufficient balance' on currency mismatch instead of a 'currency mismatch' error, masking the real cause
transfer() does not coerce amount to Decimal nor validate Account types, allowing float-based comparisons and precision drift
loan_payment() zero-rate branch returns p/m without rounding to currency precision and does not validate p/m types beyond cast
compound_interest() accepts annual_rate >= 0 but no upper bound and does not quantize the result, leaking unbounded Decimal precision
apply_fee() does not validate amount/fee types nor quantize the resulting net amount to currency precision
fx_convert() does not quantize the converted amount and accepts arbitrary rate types without validating positivity (rate could be 0 or negative)
No locking/atomicity in transfer(): partial state change is possible if an exception occurs between the two balance assignments (not transactional)
Decimal results are not rounded with an explicit ROUND_HALF_EVEN/quantize policy, risking inconsistent monetary precision across functions
